name: HTTPS Encryption in Transit
description: Percentage of traffic encrypted with HTTPS across Google products and top sites over time.

data.summary: HTTPS adoption across Google services and top-1000 websites over time.
key_facts: Google Search and Gmail reached 100% HTTPS before 2016.
Top-1000 site HTTPS adoption rose from ~48% (2015) to >95% (2023).
Chrome's HTTPS-first mode accelerated the final holdouts.
